description: Defines the ShopOrder class which models an order placed on the e-commerce website, including shopping cart items, shipping, payment, and order summaries.

classes.name: ShopOrder
classes.description: Represents a customer's order, extending PersistableOrder, with fields for cart items, shipping, payment, and order summaries.

methods.name: setShoppingCartItems
methods.description: Sets the list of shopping cart items associated with this order.

methods.name: getShoppingCartItems
methods.description: Retrieves the list of shopping cart items in this order.

methods.name: setOrderTotalSummary
methods.description: Sets the summary of totals for this order.

methods.name: getOrderTotalSummary
methods.description: Gets the summary of totals related to this order.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Retrieves the shipping summary for this order.

methods.name: setShippingSummary
methods.description: Sets the shipping summary for this order.

methods.name: getSelectedShippingOption
methods.description: Gets the shipping option selected for this order.

methods.name: setSelectedShippingOption
methods.description: Sets the shipping option for this order.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Gets any error message associated with this order.

methods.name: setErrorMessage
methods.description: Sets an error message related to this order.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodType
methods.description: Retrieves the payment method type selected for this order.

methods.name: setPaymentMethodType
methods.description: Sets the payment method type for this order.

methods.name: getPayment
methods.description: Retrieves the payment information map for this order.

methods.name: setPayment
methods.description: Sets the payment information map for this order.
